entities.name: Märtha Adlerstråhle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Märtha Vilhelmina Adlerstråhle was a Swedish tennis player. Aged 40, she won a bronze medal in the indoor singles competition at the 1908 Summer Olympics. She was the first woman to represent Sweden at the Olympics.
